statement: Between 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-04, at least one additional munition impact on the sovereign territory of Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, or the United Arab Emirates is publicly attributed to Iran or Iran-aligned forces by the host government.
resolution: MET if two of Reuters, AP, AFP report a munition impact on one of those five states dated inside the window, and that host government publicly attributes the impact to Iran or Iran-aligned forces.
failure_condition: No munition impact inside the five named states during the window carries a host-government attribution to Iran or Iran-aligned forces.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-09-04 and 2026-12-04, commercial transit of the Strait of Hormuz halts for at least 72 consecutive hours.

failure_condition: Commercial tanker traffic through the Strait continues through the window with no continuous stoppage reaching 72 hours.
